body: MAINLINE-007b filed. Advisory crimp and wrinkling are replaced by NASA CR-1457 (Sullins, Smith, Spier, 1969), the handbook restatement of Yao 1962 and Plantema 1966. Geometries are held. Infinite shear restores the kd 0.2 pressure. P2-E with Plascore 5052 at 16 kg/m3, using the smaller shear modulus: general-instability SF falls from 0.2339 to 0.2280, ratio 0.975. Yield stays 0.389. Buckling still governs. On the 007 rows at 32 and 16 kg/m3 the shear trim runs from 0.864 (Hexcel HRH-10 at 24 kg/m3) to 0.991 (Plascore at 32). No sourced core reaches the crimping branch, which starts near a shear modulus of 2.45 MPa. gamma_d stays 0.20, equal to kd, so the ratio is Kc. Foam wrinkling, equation 2.2-5 plus the equibiaxial factor 0.682, cuts the advisory uniaxial stress factor to 0.709 of itself and stays above the trimmed buckling factor. Hexcel honeycomb wrinkling, equation 2.2-14, gives equibiaxial SF 0.057 and 0.042, below buckling, so that local mode would govern if admitted. Plascore has no Ec. Densities 1 to 8 are not revised. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The brief names no further job.
